outcomes: Demonstrate the ability to recognize life-threatening emergencies and perform high-quality cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and automated external defibrillation (AED) on adult, child, and infant patients in accordance with current American Heart Association (AHA) Basic Life Support guidelines.

Apply Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) algorithms to assess and manage adult patients experiencing cardiac arrest, bradyarrhythmias, tachyarrhythmias, stroke, and acute coronary syndromes using effective airway management, pharmacological interventions, electrical therapy, and team-based resuscitation strategies.

Utilize Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) protocols to assess, triage, and treat critically ill or injured pediatric patients by identifying signs of respiratory distress, shock, and cardiac arrest, while demonstrating effective communication, rapid decision-making, and leadership within a pediatric resuscitation team.
